frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:19:The proof concerns the exact sine map, all sufficiently large parameters, and area entropy. It uses no perturbation, noise, parameter deletion, ergodicity of area, or pointwise expansion hypothesis. The constants are existential; this proof does not compute them. It does not establish the sharper conjecture `h≥log(K/2)` or a vanishing additive remainder.

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:21:The accepted source is *Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters*, at `fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb`. Both its statements and lower-level operations are premises, as instructed. The proof below audits where each operation is applied, rather than re-auditing its truth. Actual source passages, including the entire relevant sections, are bound in [source-contracts.json](../sources/i54_standard_map_additive_entropy/source-contracts.json) and [passages.json](../sources/i54_standard_map_additive_entropy/passages.json).

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:66:* `Sg_n=g_{2n}` exactly, so `S_*μ=μ+ν`, and positivity yields `μ=μ∞+Σ_{j≥1}(S⁻ʲ)_*ν`. All required local finiteness and translation invariance come from those same tests, not ergodicity. This is `scale:decomposition`.

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:221:* [Knill, math/9908014v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/9908014v2), opening notice and Conjecture 1.1: the old lower proof was withdrawn; the explicit additive estimate is conjectural. H does not recover his proposed explicit remainder. His [7–8 October 2026 author response](https://www.quantumcalculus.org/positive-entropy-for-standard-map-by-open-ai/) still distinguishes the large-parameter positivity announcement from the exact `log(K/2)` lower conjecture. This is an author status response, not proof evidence.

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:224:* [Buzzi–Crovisier–Sarig, 2103.02400v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02400v1), Theorem A and Corollary 1.1: smooth convergence of maps, appropriate ergodic measure hypotheses, and entropy convergence govern continuity of exponents. The large-K family has no such compact smooth-map limit. No uniform additive rate follows from this interface; positive entropy already known qualitatively is insufficient to use it in that way.

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:227:The accessible [MathDB problem 345911](https://mathdb.com/p/345911/sinais-positive-entropy-conjecture-for-the-standard-map) concerns Sinai's positive-entropy problem; no numerical importance score was observed. H addresses its large-parameter quantitative remainder. The mechanism proving H here is a strengthened use of accepted source operations with an elementary quantitative initialization. Its analytic consequence is distinct from positivity and S, but whether it meets the project's substantial-contribution standard requires the parent's separate judgment. It is not represented as an independent solution without the stipulated corpus, or as a priority claim.

frontier/iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md:231:The exact rare-bad-site periodic cocycle from I52 still has exponent zero: if `A(L)^{2m}=[[P,−Q],[Q,−R]]`, then `A(2Q/P)A(L)^{2m}` has trace zero and its square is −I. It is not a standard-map orbit and does not meet the full source cancellation/bridge contract. Nothing in this proof deduces H from visit frequency alone.
